reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown treat Mary's blessing among women as an external distinction only, so it does not compete with Jael's and Judith's blessed-above-women praise.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells presses the wording literally: Jael and Judith are called blessed above all women while Mary is only blessed among them, so the three superlatives cannot all hold.

sides.snippet: Blessed above women shall Jael be, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
sides.verseText: Blessed above women shall Jael be, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
Having come in, the angel said to her, \"Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!\"
